tagline: Understand what's possible. Decide what matters to you.

all.label: All resources
all.title: Resources
all.description: Browse reusable resources and projects. Find what fits your task, then copy it, download it or explore the source.

skills.label: Skills
skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Use a skill to give your AI app a saved set of steps for a specific task. The app must support skills. Some skills also include templates, files or scripts.
skills.tileDescription: Add saved steps for a repeatable task to an AI app that supports skills.
skills.emptyDescription: Each skill will name its supported app, explain any requirements and give exact setup and usage steps.
useSteps: Open a skill and check its supported app, requirements and expected outcomes.
Follow that resource’s setup steps to add the skill to the supported app. The method depends on the app and the skill.
Use the skill for your task as its resource page describes, then review the result.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Use a prompt to ask an AI assistant for a result, such as an answer, a draft or a plan. Copy the text into a chat and add the details of your task.
prompts.tileDescription: Copy text into a chat, add your task details and send it to your AI assistant.
prompts.emptyDescription: Each prompt will include text to copy, details to fill in and steps for using it.
useSteps: Open a prompt below and read its purpose, expected outcomes and requirements.
Copy the prompt into your AI assistant’s message box. Replace any bracketed fields with your own task details.
Send the message, answer any follow-up questions and review the response.

templates.label: Templates
templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Reusable files that give a familiar task a clear starting structure.

workflows.label: Workflows
workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Repeatable processes with the steps and requirements needed to use them.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Released tools and code projects, with documentation and source links.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Use instructions to set rules for how an AI assistant should respond, such as its tone, answer format or checks to follow. Save them for use within a chat or project.
instructions.tileDescription: Save response rules, such as tone or answer format, for a chat or project.
instructions.emptyDescription: Each instruction set will name the supported app, where to save the text and when the rules apply.
useSteps: Open an instruction set and check which app it supports and where its rules apply.
Adapt the rules to your needs. Save or paste them in the location named on the resource page, such as project instructions or the start of a chat.
Give the assistant your task, then check that its response follows the rules.
